test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: Five friends, A, B, C, D and E, are sitting in a straight line. A and B are adjacent to each other. B is between A and C. A is 3rd to the left of D. D is 2nd from the right. Who is sitting 3rd from the left?
solution:
Five friends, A, B, C, D and E, are sitting in a straight line.

1) D is 2nd from the right and A is 3rd to the left of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71ab5d657df713b35c959a88ab65d557cc842268555f61ff1145886945d8dac3.png] 

2) A and B are adjacent to each other and B is between A and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e5b4614f651476d23ad911c5010d88ef0c41ffd879e0518c11e8521d3c3b0e6.png] 

∴ Here, 'C' is sitting 3rd from the left.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C".**
